_note: The 'What to send for a fast quote' checklist above the enquiry form (src/pages/contact.astro). Copy only: it sits outside the enquiry form stack and changes no field. Each item restates something the site already says, with its source in 'source'. There is deliberately no reply-time promise: none is stated by Dorin anywhere in the repo. Add one here only once he states it.
heading: What to send for a fast quote
intro: None of this is required: a short note is enough to start. Each item you can send now is a question we will not need to ask later.

items.text: The address or area, the rooms, and a rough idea of the walls involved.
items.source: src/pages/contact.astro 'A useful first brief'; src/content/contact.json lede

items.text: Or a link to the paper. A code is more useful than a description, because the code decides the labour.
items.source: src/content/guides/installation-cost.md, 'How does the material change the work?'

items.text: If the paper is already bought, a photograph of the roll labels helps; if it is still to be ordered, say so and we can source it.
items.source: src/content/contact.json photoNote; src/pages/materials/[slug].astro ('We can install material you have already bought, or source a family and install it')

items.lead: Photographs of the walls as they are.
items.text: Phone photographs are fine. They show the preparation the walls will need, which can be the larger part of the time on a period wall.

items.lead: Drawings or wall sizes, if you have them.
items.text: Elevations, or widths and heights. We measure on site, or from drawings when the programme needs it.
items.source: src/content/guides/installation-cost.md ('We measure on site, or from drawings when the programme needs it'); src/content/professionals.json (elevations)

items.text: Stairs, high walls, working hours, and whether the house or hotel stays in use while we work.
items.source: src/content/guides/installation-cost.md, 'What about access, protection and the awkward parts?'

items.lead: The date you have in mind.
items.text: We will say whether it is realistic. On a tender, give both the tender deadline and the start date.
items.source: src/content/faq.json (free-issue lead time); src/data/buyer-answers.json (tender deadline vs start date)
